risks.title: Contract losses and demand volatility
risks.score_rationale: The loss of significant contracts and demand volatility in the capital equipment industries could negatively impact the company's financial results, as noted in Item 1A. The company is exposed to risks related to demand fluctuations and competition.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and IT disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Cyberattacks could disable the company's IT infrastructure and cause significant operational disruption, as noted in Item 1A. This could have an existential impact on the company.

risks.title: Internal weaknesses and controls
risks.score_rationale: Internal weaknesses, such as internal control issues, could lead to financial reporting errors and financial losses, as noted in Item 1A.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and sanctions
risks.score_rationale: The company's operations and international sanctions could negatively impact its financial results, as noted in Item 1A.

risks.title: Loss of key personnel
risks.score_rationale: The loss of key personnel could affect the company's ability to maintain operations and achieve its post-acquisition integration goals, as noted in Item 1A.

risks.title: Workplace health and safety risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's manufacturing and maintenance activities could pose health and safety risks to employees, as noted in Item 1A.

risks.title: Customer concentration risk
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on long-term customer relationships for recurring revenue (approximately 50% of total), and the loss of these relationships could negatively impact financial results, as noted in Item 1A.

risks.title: Supply chain risks
risks.score_rationale: Delays or disruptions in the supply chain, including rising raw material prices and shortages of skilled labor, could negatively impact company operations, as noted in Item 1A.
